synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis (wall row band) + holed 3x3-block pieces; render by layer (piece>reflection>target>wall) then re-extract (wall/player comps over own+0 cells ranked by bbox, reflections 4-conn, targets per sprite).
Missed mechanic at step 64: ACTION5 cycles axis -> pieces in LARGEST-FIRST order (block count desc, tie min block) -> axis, so from the 7-block L it goes to the 6-block T; the T's six 0 dots above the axis rank before the walls, which is why wall_h_0/1 become wall_h_6/7. Ordering by bbox fails only step 64.
Hole rule: a centre shows the first solid sprite below it (target); otherwise it shows the top sprite's own fill (0 if selected, 4 for a reflection, else -1). An unselected piece over a reflection stays -1 (fixed step 71).
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block (3 cells); A3/A4 move only pieces; moves stay on the 21x21 block board. Every piece block reflects to row 2A-r (r != A), clipped to the board.
